description: Mohammed Abusally Ahamed Nazeer v. Divisional Secretary of Akkaraipattu and Others Mohammed Abusally Ahamed Nazeer v. Divisional Secretary of Akkaraipattu and Others View More before Hon. S. Srikandarajah, (P/CA) J.
parties: Mohammed Abusally Ahamed Nazeer v. Divisional Secretary of Akkaraipattu and Others Mohammed Abusally Ahamed Nazeer v. Divisional Secretary of Akkaraipattu and Others View More
keywords: Petitioner challenged order made under Section 38(a) of the Land Acquisition Act; Petitioner land was acquired for public purpose after issuance of Section 2 notice when there were alternative private lands in the vicinity. Held - order was made out of urgency and Petitioner failed to establish lack of urgency. Application dismissed without costs.
legistation: The Constitution of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka
